about: Documents and files retired from this directory. The content is not kept in the tree; each row names the commit that still holds it. Read one with: forge archive show <id>

entries.name: FVTS 0.1.0 decision context for agents
entries.purpose: Working context handed to a coding agent before the first view contract was written.
entries.reason: Superseded by the FVTS page and the approved FVTS schema; D-17 U-2.

entries.name: FVTS 0.1.0 review package
entries.purpose: The draft view contract with all proposed file contents, for the owner's review.
entries.reason: Superseded by the FVTS page and the approved FVTS schema; D-17 U-2.

entries.name: Survey of Rust frontend frameworks
entries.purpose: Research into client frameworks before the forge-display design.
entries.reason: Superseded by the signed forge-display design (D-16); D-17 U-2.

entries.name: Overview of a commercial sign-in service
entries.purpose: Notes on one vendor's product and pricing, gathered before the role model.
entries.reason: Named an existing company in a public repository; the role record decides sign-in; D-17 U-2.

entries.name: Git bundle of forge-ot phases 1 to 6
entries.purpose: A transport copy of the first plant-floor commits, from before they were merged.
entries.reason: The commits are in the history; a one-time artefact; D-17 U-3.

entries.name: Patch files of forge-ot phases 1 to 6

entries.name: D3.12 verification report
entries.purpose: A one-time verification of the hub API, the pipeline, FACTS governance and the SDK round trip, with its script.
entries.reason: A frozen snapshot of a past milestone; the live suite under tests/ covers it; D-17 U-3.

entries.name: Stray copy of the command line at the top of the repository

entries.reason: Nothing used it; the command is src/forge/cli/main.py; D-17 U-3.

entries.name: TypeScript sidecar for the interim MES bridge
entries.purpose: An early attempt to let the interim MES bridge speak to the hub over gRPC.
entries.reason: Never built, tested or used, and it carried the old name prefix; the Go forge-mes is the route to the hub; D-17 U-4.

entries.reason: Nothing imported it and it had drifted from the real one (FB-019); D-17 §10.5.
